# An invoice settled by two payments, each from a different bank account.
#
# Unposting it orphans both, and the warning has to say where each one's money
# is. Totalled as a single figure, two payments made from two accounts read as
# one sum sitting in whichever account the first orphan named — so a reader
# reconciling the book looked for 100.00 in a chequing account that holds 60.00
# of it, and never heard about the 40.00 in the other one.
#
# What this fixture produces: one invoice for 100.00, posted, paid 60.00 out of
# Assets:Bank and 40.00 out of Assets:Second Bank.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_orphans_are_totalled_per_bank_account.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Second Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-TWOBANK"
	name: "Two Bank Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-TWOBANK"
	customer_id: "C-TWOBANK"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-TWOBANK"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-10
		amount: 60
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "From the chequing account"
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-25
		amount: 40
		bank_account: "Assets:Second Bank"
		memo: "From the other one"
